en.title: Relative pronouns
en.summary: A relative pronoun begins a clause that adds information about a noun.

paragraphs: A relative pronoun introduces a clause that gives more information about a noun. English has who, whom, whose, which and that.

items: The man **who** called is my uncle.
The book **that** I read was long.
A friend **whose** car broke down came.

paragraphs: Use who for people, which for things, and that for either. Whose shows possession. In everyday speech the pronoun can be left out when it is the object: The book I read was long.
